Judgment calls: (a) MOSFET symbol decoding. All six transistors use the same glyph: a solid gate bar with its lead on one side, a 3-segment broken channel line parallel to it, a lead off each outer channel segment, and the body arrow on the middle segment whose tail runs into ONE of the leads. That body-tied lead is taken as the SOURCE and the opposite one as the DRAIN (verified at 8-12x on raw pixels for all six). For 14, 5, 9, 11 the gate bar sits above the channel and the leads hang below; for 2 and 4 the symbol is mirrored vertically - gate bar BELOW the channel (2: the line (183,381)->(152,388) with its lead running down at x~153; 4: the line (322,368)->(290,374) with its lead running down at x~290) and the leads run up and out. In every case the body arrow ties to the LEFT lead, so source = left lead and drain = right lead for all six. Arrow directions corroborate the classes: 14/5/9 (N) point into the channel, 11/2/4 (P) point away. (b) Crossings. Three semicircular hops are drawn and were confirmed at high zoom: the n1 gate rail hops MOSFET 5's gate line at (248,136) and hops MOSFET 11's source line at (331,124); there is also a hop on the n1 rail near (238,136) same feature. Everything else that meets is a T or a filled dot (e.g. the fat dot at (213,357), the 4-way at (341,219) which has no hop and is therefore a junction). (c) OFF-FRAME COMPONENTS - three of them, none visible in the 512x512 crop:   * V-AC 10, bbox centre (143.5,-21.3) i.e. just above the top edge spanning x 125-162. Exactly three wires leave the top edge: x=73 (the ground line), x=223 (the n4 gate line) and x=408 (the dashed n5 line). Projected up to y=-21 they sit at x~71, x~218 and x~406. V-AC 10 straddles x 125-162, i.e. it sits between the x=73 and the x=223 stubs, exactly the way the visible V-AC 8 sits with its left lead running ~46 px left onto the ground rail. So V-AC 10 left lead = 0, right lead = n4.   * Zener 13, bbox centre (360.3,-49.3), spanning x 341-379, higher up and further right. It sits between the same n4 stub (x~215 at y=-49) and the x=408 stub (x~406 at y=-49), so Zener 13 bridges n4 and n5. That means the n4 wire branches off-frame (once to V-AC 10's right lead, once to the zener), which is the only reading that leaves no stub unused and no off-frame terminal dangling.   * I-AC 0, bbox centre (241.3,547.8), below the bottom edge spanning x 219-264. Exactly two wires leave the bottom edge: the ground line at x=141 and MOSFET 4's gate line at x=306. I-AC 0 sits between them, so its left lead = 0 and its right lead = n8. This also makes the circuit symmetric: MOSFET 2's gate is driven by the visible I-AC 3 returning to ground, and MOSFET 4's gate by the off-frame I-AC 0 returning to ground. None of the three is marked unconnected - they are invisible, not dangling.
